title: holds 32 oz not 40
text: holds 32 oz not 40. the containers get 3 stars for incorrectly advertising the size...........these hold 32 ounces, not 40 as listed.  if you fill to the rim, at the overflow stage, you can get 40 ounces in.  However.........when you freeze food, you have to leave 1 inch between the food and the lid because wet things expand when they freeze.  if you over fill the container, the lid will blow off.
